applicabilityBasis.summary: Sonic Labs markets USSD as a Treasury-backed, 1:1 mint/redeem dollar built on GENIUS-compatible frxUSD infrastructure; the issuer's public positioning treats it as a payment stablecoin subject to the GENIUS Act.

genius.notes: Sonic Labs publicly markets USSD as 'fully compatible with the GENIUS Act' and has established Sonic USA LLC (Delaware) for U.S. regulatory engagement. No PPSI application, OCC/FDIC/Federal Reserve filing, or state-qualified authorization has been found. The GENIUS Act rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase with no PPSI approvals granted to any issuer as of 2026-06-18. Foreign exception status updated to not-applicable as the issuer is U.S.-domiciled.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official GENIUS Act application filing, or comparable foreign-issuer exception was located for USSD or Sonic Labs / Sonic USA LLC in any federal or state regulatory database. Sonic Labs' GENIUS compatibility claims are issuer marketing, not regulatory disclosures.
